description: This file contains JavaScript functions for auto-completing country and state/province fields, fetching associated lists via AJAX, and handling UI interactions in an order management web application.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Initiates an AJAX request to retrieve the list of countries for auto-completion.

methods.name: callCountryAutocompleter
methods.description: Sets up the country input field with autocomplete functionality using fetched country list.

methods.name: setKeyAsParameterAndGetStateList
methods.description: Stores selected country ID and triggers fetching of associated states.

methods.name: getAssociatedStateListForAutoComplete
methods.description: Fetches list of states/provinces associated with the selected country via AJAX.

methods.name: callStateAutocompleter
methods.description: Initializes autocomplete for state/province field based on fetched data and manages UI adjustments.

methods.name: setKeyAsParameter
methods.description: Stores the selected state/province ID in a hidden target.

methods.name: getAssociatedStateList
methods.description: Fetches and populates a dropdown with states/provinces for a given country asynchronously.
